text:
maria: Quick design review — I'm thinking of adding a subtle banner above the schema editor when 'Param Suggest' is on. Purpose: explain what it does + keyboard shortcut. Thoughts?
aj: Love the idea. Two accessibility asks: 1) banner must be dismissible via keyboard (Esc), 2) screenreader should announce it as an informative region, not a dialog.
sam k: Can we keep the banner short? engineers hate long blurbs. Maybe one sentence + a 'Learn more' link that opens docs.
lina: Agree. Also we should include an ARIA label like `role="status"` so NVDA/VoiceOver will speak it immediately. Avoid focus trap.
maria: Good call. UX copy draft: "Param Suggest helps prefill function args from conversation context. Toggle it with Ctrl+Option+P — learn more." Too wordy?
aj: Suggest: "Param Suggest auto-fills args from recent messages. Toggle: ⌘⇧P (Mac) / Ctrl+Shift+P (Win)." Shorter and includes shortcuts. Add visually hidden text that explains it's non-modal.
sam k: Shortcut collisions maybe. We should detect platform and show the right combo. Also we need a small icon button to pin the banner so it reappears after dismiss.
lina: For accessibility, pinned state should have an accessible name, e.g., "Keep Param Suggest banner visible" and update `aria-pressed`.
maria: Implementation question: should dismiss store in localStorage or user settings (server)? For now localStorage is fine for prototype, but product asked for account-level persist.
aj: Prototype -> localStorage; file a follow-up task to move to settings. Also add telemetry: banner_shown, banner_dismissed, banner_pinned. No PII.
sam k: In run history, we should show whether Param Suggest was used on a given invocation. Could be a tiny pill next to run timestamp: "PS:on" or "PS:off". Designers: opinions?
lina: Pill needs color contrast compliant and a tooltip for screenreaders that reads "Param Suggest enabled for this run". If PS:on, set `aria-label` accordingly.
maria: Copy for tooltip: "Param Suggest was applied to autofill function arguments for this run."
aj: Edge case: if Param Suggest filled a required arg incorrectly, we should surface a one-click revert in the run inspector. Add a small "Revert suggestions" action in the callstack.
sam k: Good. Dev note: put a 1px dashed border to visually separate the revert action; engineers like small affordances.
lina: Accessibility nit: ensure the revert action is reachable by keyboard and announced as a button: `role="button" aria-label="Revert parameter suggestions"`.
maria: I'll update the Figma, add copy variants, and attach a short accessibility checklist. Ping me when prototypes are up and I'll run quick keyboard walkthrough. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Deploy preview ready: https://redwood-inference.internal/proto/param-suggest-banner (expires in 48h)
aj: I'll test on VoiceOver and NVDA later today and drop notes here. Thanks all!
